user.title: Create Climate Group
user.description: Set up a new mini split climate group with priority-based control

data.name: Group Name
data.tolerance: Tolerance (degrees outside target before mode change)

data_description.temp_sensor: Leave empty to base this room's decisions on the unit's own temperature reading. Pick a sensor to use it instead, for example when the unit sits high on a wall.

priority.title: Priority Order

error.entity_not_found: Entity not found. Please check that the selected entities exist.

data.tolerance: Tolerance (degrees outside target before asking for heat or cool)
data.hysteresis: Hysteresis (buffer before a room counts as back on target)

room_sensor.title: Room temperature source
room_sensor.description: Pick a room. By default decisions use the unit's own temperature reading.

room_sensor_edit.title: Temperature source for {room}
room_sensor_edit.description: Pick a sensor to base {room}'s decisions on it, or clear the field to use the unit's own reading.

set_target_temperature.name: Set room target
set_target_temperature.description: Set one room's target temperature. Other rooms keep theirs.

set_member_power.name: Set room power
set_member_power.description: With automation on, off pauses the room and on resumes it. With automation off, turns the unit on (in the group mode) or off.

on.name: On
on.description: Turn the room on (true) or off (false).

set_automation.name: Set automation
set_automation.description: On: priority decides the mode and turns rooms on and off. Off: you choose mode and power; running units are kept in the group mode.

set_mode.name: Set group mode
set_mode.description: Choose heat or cool by hand. This turns automation off and switches running units to the new mode.

set_tolerance.name: Set tolerance
set_tolerance.description: How far a room can drift from its target before it asks for heat or cool.

set_hysteresis.name: Set hysteresis
set_hysteresis.description: Buffer before a room counts as back on target and its unit turns off.

set_priority_order.name: Set default priority
set_priority_order.description: Priority order used when no schedule is active (highest first).

priority_order.name: Priority order
priority_order.description: List of room ids, highest priority first.

set_schedules.name: Set schedules
set_schedules.description: Replace the group's priority schedules. Each has a name, start and end (HH:MM; an end before the start runs overnight), days, and a priority order.

reset_to_default.name: Reset room target
reset_to_default.description: Reset a room's target to its configured default.
